objective of the mission is to reduce the uncertainty in the worldwide
spatial distribution and dynamics of forest biomass in order to improve
current assessments and future projections of the global carbon cycle.

The objective will be achieved by implementation of a P-band SAR mission,
providing global maps of forest biomass stocks, forest disturbance and
growth.

This notification of Intended Invitation To Tender concerns the procurement
of Central Electronics Subsystem (CES) by Airbus DS GmbH as a Core team 
member of the Biomass project. The supplier selection will be made in 
accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.

The scope of this procurement covers the design, development (including the
required qualification activities), manufacturing, testing and delivery of
the CES.

The Central Electronics Subsystem (CES) is the heart of the Biomass 
instrument. It is an assembly of several equipments, connected by internal 
harness up to and including a connector bracket and mounted on the MXPZ
panel wall of the Instrument/satellite.

The CES contains all units required to form a full, cold redundant radar 
core including all networks required for internal calibration, plus the 
Boot Software. 

One important EGSE of the CES procurement is the INES SCOE that shall be 
used both at CES level by the contractor and at instrument level by Airbus 
Defence and Space. 

The INES SCOE shall be used to operate, test, and checkout the CES. The 
INES SCOE will also need to offer all interfaces from the satellite 
avionics to the PAS, RAS-V and RAS-H in addition to the functions described 
for the operation of the INES SCOE on CES level. For this purpose, the INES 
SCOE shall provide the same interfaces types, interface connectors and 
functionalities as provided by the satellite avionics, allowing interface 
verification and functional testing on instrument level.

The INES SCOE is expected to be procured by the successful CES bidder under 
Best Practice Open competition and under the management of the CES bidder. 

In this framework, the present Invitation To Tender will be addressed to
economic operators (including those deemed to act as subcontractors) whose
registered office is established in such Member and Associated States
which, by the time of the Contract award decision, will be a participating
State in the ESA Biomass project. 

The following States are participating in the said Programme: Austria,
Belgium, Canada, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany,
Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland,
Portugal, Romania, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

normalized.description:
K 7 Premium Full Control Plus ofera un control mai mare si o experienta nemaintalnita in utilizare datorita pistolului inovativ cu butoane de comanda +/- pentru reglarea presiunii si a detergentului, afisaj LCD pentru a seta si vizualiza presiunea potrivita pentru fiecare suprafata intalnita. In momentul cand doriti sa comutati de la presiune ridicata la modul de detergent, cu lancea de pulverizare multifunctionala 3-in-1, nu esti nevoit sa schimbi lancea de pulverizare. Versatilitatea pistolului si a lancii de pulverizare anuleaza cu usurinta intreruperile scurte din timpul curatarii, acestea fiind asezate cu usurinta in aparat. Procesul de curatare este mai usor si mai confortabil datorita manerului telescopic cu inaltime reglabila (pentru manevrare usoara si depozitare compacta), sistemului Plug&Clean foarte usor de utilizat (pentru a schimba detergentul cu o miscare usoara), ghidajului pentru furtun si bazei stabile (poate fi utilizata ca un al doilea maner de transport). Centrul de greutate situat mai jos ofera o stabilitate mai mare. Curatitorul cu apa sub presiune este ideal pentru curatare regulata pe murdarie persistenta cu ghidaj pentru furtun si un randament pe suprafata de 60 m²/h.
